name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Switches between views of the same content; SegmentedControl switches a small set of options inline.

when: Two to seven views of one thing: Overview, Activity, Settings.

instead.when: Options act on content instead of switching views.

builtIn: Tabs and panels are linked; counts are announced.

genui.description: Tabs switching between views. items are {id, label, count?, panel?}; panel is the tab's text content. Emits change.
